products.name: Cirrus 2 Tent
products.materials: 20D ripstop nylon fly, DAC Featherlite poles
products.care: Dry completely before storage; store loosely, never compressed.

products.name: Stratus 3 Tent
products.care: Rinse zippers with fresh water after coastal trips.

products.name: Nimbus 1 Tent
products.care: Reapply seam sealant annually if pitched more than 30 nights a year.

products.name: Kestrel 48 Pack
products.care: Hand wash with mild soap; never machine dry.

products.name: Swift 24 Daypack
products.care: Spot clean; air dry away from direct sun.

products.name: Meridian Rain Shell
products.care: Wash cool, tumble low, iron on low to revive DWR.

products.name: Boreal Down Parka
products.care: Wash with down-specific soap; dry with clean tennis balls.

products.name: Gale Wind Anorak
products.care: Machine wash cold in a mesh bag.

products.name: Ember Canister Stove
products.care: Check the O-ring before each season; replace if cracked.

products.name: Hearth Remote Stove
products.care: Invert-canister use requires the included windscreen.

products.name: Drift 20 Quilt
products.care: Store uncompressed in the supplied cotton sack.

products.name: Tarn Inflatable Pad
products.care: Inflate with the pump sack, not breath, to limit interior moisture.

products.name: Cairn Foam Pad
products.care: Trim to length with ordinary scissors if desired; trimming voids nothing.

products.name: Talus Trekking Poles
products.care: Dry the sections separated after wet trips to prevent seizing.

products.name: Wren Headlamp
products.care: Firmware updates ship via the companion desktop tool.

policies.returnsExclusions: Final-sale items and used fuel canisters cannot be returned.
policies.warrantyExclusions: UV degradation of tent flies and normal DWR wear are excluded from the warranty.

sizing.shellSizes: XS through XXL; the Meridian and Gale run a half size large, the Boreal runs true.
sizing.packTorsoRanges: Kestrel and Merlin fit 16 to 21 inch torsos; the Swift is one-size.
